text:
pagerbot: ALERT: auth-service anomalous behavior detected. 401->200 flapping + unusual token entropy in telemetry. spike across eu-west-1, us-east-1. potential debug-log uploads to staging S3 bucket. severity: high. runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/auth-exposure
alice-oncall: ack. I'm on it, standing up triage channel. marking pager. @clara-secops can you join? I'll snapshot current state.
bob-sre: pulling logs now. found repeated uploads to s3://staging-logs/tmp/debug-2026-03-18/*. one file contains plaintext session fragments. truncating output:
```
$ aws s3 cp s3://staging-logs/tmp/debug-2026-03-18/part-0001.log - | head -n 40
[2026-03-18T16:05:12Z] DEBUG auth: session_token=***REDACTED*** user_id=1234
[2026-03-18T16:05:12Z] DEBUG ingest: svc_account=ingest-shipper key=AKIA... masked
```
bob-sre: uploader appears to be service account ingest-shipper. timestamps line up with deploy at ~15:58 UTC.
clara-secops: understood. treat as potential secret exposure. immediate steps: 1) disable debug logshipper on staging, 2) rotate ingest-shipper service token, 3) block suspicious IP ranges at WAF, 4) notify legal/CS. I'll coordinate rotations.
alice-oncall: doing 1) now — disabling debug env var on staging cluster.
alice-oncall: `kubectl -n staging set env deploy/logshipper LOG_LEVEL=info` -> done. logs should stop containing tokens in ~10s.
dana-platops: applying WAF block for IP ranges seen in telemetry: 54.23.12.0/24, 3.14.159.0/24. pushing rule id: waf-2026-03-18-01
clara-secops: initiating token rotation for ingest-shipper. running rotation command (internal):
```
infractl rotate-service-token ingest-shipper --force --notify=on
```
clara-secops: rotation started. expected 60s to propagate. will fail open if not confirmed — monitoring.
bob-sre: scanning S3 for other objects with debug prefix and moving to quarantine bucket `quarantine-staging-3240000001`.
bob-sre: `aws s3 mv s3://staging-logs/tmp/debug-2026-03-18/ s3://quarantine-staging-3240000001/ --recursive` -> 23 files moved. retaining copies per forensic policy.
erin-cs: CS standby. any customer impact? do we have evidence of exfil beyond internal staging bucket?
clara-secops: no confirmed exfil to external destinations yet. WAF blocks applied. timeline indicates likely internal misconfig (debug enabled in deploy) + crawlers hitting public endpoints. prepare preliminary customer note anyway — likely internal, low customer impact but we need to be proactive.
mike-legal: on call. preserve chain of custody. don't delete original objects until we confirm required artifacts. legal to join incident response call in 10.
alice-oncall: assigning tasks: bob-sre -> full S3 audit & quarantine verification; clara-secops -> rotate keys + audit token usage; dana-platops -> blocklist and cluster config check; erin-cs -> draft customer message. I'll hand off on-call to bob in 15m.
alice-oncall: handing off to @bob-sre for next 4h — posting summary in incident tracker.
bob-sre: ack takeover. I'll monitor propagation and confirm no further uploads. putting a short checklist in tracker: (1) confirm no new debug uploads; (2) validate rotated token is not in use; (3) run grep across snapshot for credential patterns; (4) produce short incident timeline.
clara-secops: rotation finished. new token active. invalidating old token now.
clara-secops: `infractl revoke-token ingest-shipper --token old-abc123` -> success. monitoring auth logs for failed attempts — none so far.
erin-cs: drafted short CS note: "We observed internal staging logs containing session fragments due to a debug flag. No customer data exfiltration detected. We rotated internal tokens and quarantined files. We'll follow up with a full timeline." sharing draft doc: https://redwood-internal/cs/incidents/3240000001/draft
mike-legal: confirm retention policy for quarantined files and request forensic snapshot. legal approves proactive CS message but add conditional wording re: investigation.
bob-sre: confirming no new debug objects in last 5m. grep summary: 0 matches in current bucket after quarantine. still running quick grep across backups.
bob-sre: next: re-deploy with defensive env check to ensure debug flags are not set in prod/staging. adding helm chart guard.
alice-oncall: thanks all. we'll keep this open until legal signs off and CS publishes customer comms. if anything new, ping @pagerbot to reopen. incident thread end-for-now. :thumbsup:
